description: Full KYB (know your business) check on a UK company number in one call: profile and status, officers, owners (PSCs), overdue filings, registered charges, insolvency, a disqualified-director screen on the board, and Gazette notices, with a risk summary. For supplier onboarding, due diligence and anti-fraud. (cost: 6 credits)

screenDirectors.description: boolean, default true: also screen directors against the disqualified register
